definitions.explanation: A closed loop or network through which electric current can flow. Studied in physics and engineering; the foundation of all electronic devices.

examples.japanese: {電気回路|でんきかいろ}の{基本|きほん}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned the basics of electric circuits.

examples.japanese: {電気回路|でんきかいろ}が{断線|だんせん}して{電気|でんき}がつかなくなった。
examples.english: The electric circuit broke and the power stopped working.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}の{物理|ぶつり}で{電気回路|でんきかいろ}の{仕組|しく}みについて{詳|くわ}しく{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: In high school physics, I studied in detail how electrical circuits work.

notes:
Compound of {電気|でんき} (electricity) + {回路|かいろ} (circuit; loop). The shorter form {回路|かいろ} alone is also common in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気回路|でんきかいろ}を{設計|せっけい}する: to design an electric circuit
- {電気回路|でんきかいろ}を{組|く}む: to assemble a circuit
- {電気回路図|でんきかいろず}: circuit diagram
- {短絡|たんらく}: short circuit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回路|かいろ}: circuit — the shorter, more technical form
- {電子回路|でんしかいろ}: electronic circuit — circuits using semiconductor components
